meanings.usage: 通常指官方颁发的许可证书，如驾驶执照 driving licence
指道路上的车辆和行人流动，heavy traffic 表示交通拥挤
指对自己能力的信任，acquire confidence 表示获得信心
指进行考试或检查的人员
指某人做事或完成任务的方式
指给予明确指示或指导，instructed 为过去式/过去分词
用于提出假设情况，let us suppose 表示让我们假设
指对某事物做出反应或回应
作名词指刹车装置，作动词指刹车动作
指用脚操作的装置，如刹车踏板 brake pedal
过去式 threw，过去分词 thrown，throw forward 表示向前抛出
指用手或物体对另一物体施加压力，如按刹车
指在中断后继续做某事或不停顿地做下去
指通过努力或过程逐渐获得知识、技能或信心

phrases.usage: 被要求做某事，表示被动地接受指示或要求

examples.en: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 我被要求在拥挤的交通中驾驶。

phrases.usage: 开车出城，表示从市区驶出

examples.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
examples.zh: 在接到开车出城的指示后，我开始有了信心。

phrases.usage: 确信，确信某事会发生或已经发生

examples.en: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
examples.zh: 确信自己已经通过了，我几乎开始享受这次考试。

phrases.usage: 表示对过去发生的事情的肯定推测

examples.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance.
examples.zh: 主考官一定对我的表现很满意。

phrases.usage: 一...就...，表示两个动作紧接着发生

examples.en: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.
examples.zh: 我一敲车窗，你就必须在五英尺内停车。

phrases.usage: 花费一些时间，表示某事需要一定的时间才能完成

examples.en: It took me a long time to react.
examples.zh: 我花了很长时间才反应过来。

phrases.usage: 悲伤地看着某人，表示带着悲伤的表情注视

examples.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.

phrases.usage: 用悲伤的声音，表示以哀伤的语调说话

examples.en: He said in a mournful voice.

phrases.usage: 踩刹车踏板，指驾驶员刹车时的动作

examples.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard.
examples.zh: 我突然用力踩下刹车踏板。

phrases.usage: 被向前抛出，描述因惯性身体前倾的状态

grammar.title: 过去进行时的被动语态 (Past Continuous Tense - Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + being + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的被动动作，由 was/were + being + 过去分词构成 用于描述过去某个时刻正在发生的被动动作，强调动作的进行性

examples.en: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
examples.zh: 我正在第三次参加驾照考试。

grammar.title: 过去完成时的被动语态 (Past Perfect Tense - Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + been + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的被动动作，由 had + been + 过去分词构成 用于描述在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的被动动作，常与 after 连用

examples.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
examples.zh: 在被指示开出城后，我开始有了信心。

grammar.title: 情态动词 must 表示对过去的肯定推测 (Must have + 过去分词)
grammar.structure: 主语 + must have + 过去分词
grammar.definition: must have + 过去分词表示对过去发生的事情的肯定推测，意为"一定/肯定已经..." 用于根据现有证据或情况对过去的事情做出强有力的推断，语气比 may/might have 更肯定

examples.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance.
examples.zh: 主考官一定对我的表现很满意。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were being + 过去分词

original.en: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
original.zh: 我正在第三次参加驾照考试。

imitations.en: The car was being repaired when I arrived.
imitations.zh: 当我到达时，那辆车正在被修理。

imitations.en: The patient was being examined by the doctor.

patterns.pattern: After having been + 过去分词...

original.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
original.zh: 在被指示开车出城后，我开始有了信心。

imitations.en: After having been given instructions, we started the project.
imitations.zh: 在接到指示后，我们开始了项目。

imitations.en: After having been told the truth, she felt relieved.
imitations.zh: 在被告知真相后，她感到如释重负。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + must have been + 过去分词

original.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance.
original.zh: 主考官一定对我的表现很满意。

imitations.en: She must have been waiting for hours.
imitations.zh: 她一定已经等了好几个小时。

imitations.en: He must have been sleeping when you called.
imitations.zh: 你打电话时他一定正在睡觉。

patterns.pattern: As soon as + 主语 + 动词...

original.en: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.
original.zh: 我一敲车窗，你就必须在五英尺内停车。

imitations.en: As soon as the light turns green, you can go.
imitations.zh: 一绿灯亮起，你就可以走了。

imitations.en: As soon as he saw me, he smiled.

lines.en: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
lines.zh: 我第3次接受驾驶执照考试。

lines.en: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully .
lines.zh: 按照要求在车辆拥挤的路上驾驶，我圆满地完成了。

lines.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence .
lines.zh: 在接到把车开出城的指令后，我开始有了信心。确信我已通过考试，所以我几乎开始喜欢起这次考试。

lines.en: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
lines.zh: 主考人对我的驾驶想必是满意的，因为他微笑着说：“埃姆斯先生，只剩1项了。

lines.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said.
lines.zh: 让我们假设一个小孩子突然在你前面穿过马路。
我一敲车窗，你必须把车停在5英尺之内。

lines.en: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，主考人砰砰地敲了起来。

lines.en: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly, Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react .
lines.zh: 虽然声音听得很清楚，但我过了好一会儿才作出反应。

lines.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal and we were both thrown forward.
lines.zh: 我突然用力踩紧刹车踏板，结果我俩的身体都向前冲去。

lines.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.
'Mr.Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'
lines.zh: “埃姆斯先生，”他以悲伤的声调说，“你刚刚把那个小孩压死了！”

questions.q: Do you think that the writer passed his driving test? Why?
questions.zh: 你认为作者通过这次驾驶考试了吗？为什么？
questions.a: No, he didn't. He reacted too slowly to the examiner's tap and stopped far beyond five feet, so the examiner said in a mournful voice that he had just killed that child.
questions.aZh: 没有通过。他反应太慢，刹车时车早已冲出5英尺，主考人悲伤地说他刚把那个小孩压死了。
questions.hint: 见 Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react. 及末句。

questions.q: Why did the writer begin to acquire confidence during the test?
questions.zh: 考试途中作者为什么开始有了信心？
questions.a: Because he had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully, and after having been instructed to drive out of town he felt sure that he had passed.
questions.aZh: 因为按要求在拥挤车流中驾驶他完成得很圆满，又被指令把车开出城后，他确信自己已经通过。
questions.hint: 见 I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully。

questions.q: What exactly did the examiner ask the writer to do in the last part of the test?
questions.zh: 主考人在最后一项中要求作者做什么？
questions.a: He asked him to suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road and to stop within five feet as soon as he tapped on the window.
questions.aZh: 他让作者假设一个小孩突然横穿马路，并在他一敲车窗时把车停在5英尺之内。
questions.hint: 见 Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you。

questions.q: Was there a real child on the road? Why did the examiner say 'you have just killed that child'?
questions.zh: 路上真有小孩吗？主考人为什么那样说？
questions.a: No, there was no real child; it was only a supposition. The examiner said it because the writer took so long to react that he would have knocked the child down long before stopping.
questions.aZh: 没有真的小孩，那只是假设。因为作者反应太慢、停车远超5英尺，换作真有孩子早就被撞倒了。
questions.hint: 见 Let us suppose… 与 we were both thrown forward。

questions.q: Why is the lesson called 'But not murder!'? Where does the humour lie?
questions.zh: 课文为什么取名“并非谋杀！”？幽默在哪里？
questions.a: The title plays on the word murder: failing a test is not murder, yet the examiner's mournful verdict 'you have just killed that child' treats the mistake as if it were a killing.
questions.aZh: 标题拿 murder 开玩笑：考砸并不等于谋杀，可主考人的判词把一次失误说成了人命案，反差越大越可笑。
questions.hint: 结合标题与末句 in a mournful voice。

translation:
我第3次接受驾驶执照考试。
按照要求在车辆拥挤的路上驾驶，我圆满地完成了。
在接到把车开出城的指令后，我开始有了信心。
确信我已通过考试，所以我几乎开始喜欢起这次考试。
主考人对我的驾驶想必是满意的，因为他微笑着说：“埃姆斯先生，只剩1项了。
让我们假设一个小孩子突然在你前面穿过马路。
我一敲车窗，你必须把车停在5英尺之内。
”我继续往前开着。
过了一会儿，主考人砰砰地敲了起来。
虽然声音听得很清楚，但我过了好一会儿才作出反应。
我突然用力踩紧刹车踏板，结果我俩的身体都向前冲去。
主考人伤心地看着我。
“埃姆斯先生，”他以悲伤的声调说，“你刚刚把那个小孩压死了！”
title: But not murder!
subtitle: 并非谋杀！

lead.question: 最后一次路考中，“我”到底有没有通过？主考人为何说他压死了小孩？
lead.warmup: 第三次路考，前半段出奇顺利：作者在拥挤车流中平稳驾驶，又被指令把车开出城，于是信心渐生，几乎开始享受这场考试。主考人微笑着说“只剩一项了”，让他设想一个孩子突然横穿马路，敲窗后必须在5英尺内停住。故事到此还是喜剧，结局却急转直下。
goals: 掌握被动语态的过去进行时 was being tested 与 after having been instructed
会用 must have been pleased with、in a mournful voice、let sb do 等表达
能复述这次路考全过程，并讲清标题 “But not murder!” 的幽默所在
lead.summary: 本课复习被动语态的进阶用法：过去进行时被动 was being tested、介词+动名词的被动完成式 after having been instructed、情态推测 must have been pleased with。情节上，作者信心最足的一刻正是翻车的一刻：反应慢半拍，刹车时车早已冲过5英尺。幽默全在标题双关。
lead.tips: 写 after having been instructed 时别漏掉 having；口语里换成从句 After I had been instructed 更自然。

exercises.q: 语法填空：After having been ______ (instruct) to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
exercises.note: 介词后接动名词被动完成式。

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：They were testing me for a driving licence for the third time.
exercises.a: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.

exercises.q: 汉译英（用 acquire）：玛丽五年之内学会了汉语。
exercises.a: Mary acquired a good knowledge of Chinese in five years' time.

exercises.q: 完成句子：The examiner smiled. He ______ (一定是满意的) my performance.
填空：As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop ______ five feet.
填空：I suddenly pressed the brake ______ and we were both thrown forward.
用 have difficulty (in) doing 改写：It took me a long time to react to the tap.
exercises.a: I had difficulty (in) reacting to the tap.

quiz.q: 主考人对“我”的驾驶表现所持的态度是：
options: He must have been pleased with my performance.
He was disappointed with my performance.
He was afraid of my performance.
He was tired of my performance.

quiz.q: 主考人要求“我”把车停在什么范围之内？
“I was being tested for a driving licence” 的时态与语态是：
“After having been instructed to drive out of town” 属于哪种结构？
options: after + the perfect gerund passive (having been done)
after + the plain gerund passive (being done)

quiz.q: 主考人用悲伤的声调说的是哪一句？
options: 'Mr. Eames, you have just killed that child!'
'Let us suppose that a child crosses the road.'
'I was being tested for the third time.'

quiz.q: “Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road.” 中的 suppose 意为：
